description.message: Color picker and eyedropper: get the HEX, RGB, HSL or CSS filter code of any color on screen, see its name, save color palettes.

eyedropper.description: Screen reader name of the button that picks a color from the screen.

copyColorName.description: Screen reader name of the color name button, which copies the name. Keep $COLOR_NAME$.

settings.description: Settings page heading and the gear button's screen reader name.

saveColor.description: Screen reader name of the + button that saves the color.

selectedColor.description: Screen reader name of the color field that opens the color picker.

filterFormat.description: Last format tab, after HEX, RGB, HSL and HSV: the CSS filter. One short word.

copyColorCode.description: Screen reader name of the button that copies the color code.

moveColors.description: Screen reader name of the tool that reorders saved colors.

tintsAndShades.description: Screen reader name of the tool that shows lighter and darker colors.

deleteColors.description: Screen reader name of the tool that deletes saved colors one by one.

deleteAllColors.description: Screen reader name of the tool that deletes all saved colors.

downloadPng.description: Screen reader name of the tool that downloads the palette as an image. Keep PNG.

downloadCsv.description: Screen reader name of the tool that downloads the palette as a CSV file. Keep CSV.

colorsPerLine.description: Screen reader name of the menu that sets colors per row (5 to 10).

deleteAllConfirmation.description: Question asked before all saved colors are deleted.

back.description: Screen reader name of the arrow button that leaves Settings.

theme.description: Settings label of the light and dark theme switch.

darkTheme.description: Screen reader name of the theme switch, on when the theme is dark.

autoSaveEyedropper.description: Settings switch: save every eyedropper pick to the palette.

autoCopyCode.description: Settings switch: copy the code when a color is saved or clicked.

addHashToHex.description: Settings switch: start HEX codes with #. Keep # and HEX.

showColorName.description: Settings switch: show the color's name in the popup and the PNG.

prependBlackToFilter.description: Settings switch: make the CSS filter turn the element black first.

website.description: Settings button that opens ColorPal's website.

version.description: Version in Settings, such as v2.1.0. Keep $VERSION$; use a short mark like v, not a word.

ratingReminderTitle.description: Title of the rating card. Keep ColorPal.

ratingReminder.message: A quick rating on the Chrome Web Store helps others find it.
ratingReminder.description: Sentence on the rating card. Name the Chrome Web Store as Chrome does in your language.

notNow.description: Rating card button that closes the card.

rateColorPal.description: Button on the rating card and in Settings that opens the store reviews. Keep ColorPal.

languageCode.description: This file's language code, such as en, de or pt-BR. Not translated.
